details: The June US employment report revealed only 57,000 new jobs, falling significantly short of the 115,000 expected. The unemployment rate eased to 4.2%. This weaker-than-anticipated data has substantially lowered market expectations for imminent Federal Reserve interest rate hikes, creating a more favorable environment for risk assets, including cryptocurrencies. Bitcoin climbed above $61,800, and Ethereum surged over 5% following the news.
title: Weak US Jobs Data Boosts Crypto, Reduces Fed Rate Hike Odds

details: Bitcoin broke above $61,000 and Ethereum gained significantly, with both benefiting from weakened US jobs data that fueled hopes for Federal Reserve monetary easing. While some reports indicated over $220 million in positive net inflows to US spot Bitcoin ETFs during this recovery, the market is still navigating the aftermath of record $4.5 billion outflows in June. This mixed institutional sentiment reflects a cautious rebound.
title: Bitcoin and Ethereum Rebound Amid Mixed ETF Flows

details: The CLARITY Act, a pivotal piece of legislation aimed at defining cryptocurrency regulatory boundaries in the US, continues to face significant hurdles. A previous July 4th signing target is now considered highly improbable, and ongoing legislative challenges suggest that comprehensive crypto regulation could be delayed significantly, possibly until 2030. This prolonged regulatory uncertainty is a key factor impacting institutional adoption and market sentiment.
title: CLARITY Act Faces Low Odds for Near-Term Passage, Uncertainty Persists

details: The European Central Bank (ECB) has raised its key interest rates to 2.25% in response to persistent inflation across the Eurozone. This move signals a further tightening of global monetary policy and could increase the cost of capital for businesses and investors. While there are some indications of easing inflation in regions like Germany's North Rhine-Westphalia, suggesting potential future rate cuts, the immediate effect of the hike is a more restrictive macroeconomic environment.
title: ECB Hikes Rates to 2.25% Amid Persistent Inflation, Tightening Global Liquidity
